uncertain: Engineering Labs proportions, internal obstructions and corridor bends are schematic.
Q5 represents an approximate machine location in the lower Labs; duplicate machines are not drawn. Q6 is approximate within the northern side of Tinker’s Court.
Dark Iron Ambassador is rare; marker 5 is an approximate search location in the approach corridor, not a guaranteed spawn point.

notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
J is a bidirectional elevator, not a teleporter.

Suggested full-clear numbering: Grubbis, Viscous Fallout, Electrocutioner 6000, Crowd Pummeler 9-60, optional Dark Iron Ambassador, Mekgineer Thermaplugg. This is a route choice, not a mandatory encounter sequence.
The lower Labs side connection H makes a loop through the elevator and the upper Labs connection F.
Distributed quest drops and scattered collection objects are not assigned invented fixed positions.
